parameters.query:
with _r as (
update leads set
  first_name = $2, last_name = $3, full_name = $4, title = $5, headline = $6, location = $7, about = $8,
  company_name = $9, company_domain = $10, company_linkedin_url = $11, company_size = $12, industry = $13,
  company_description = $14, work_email = $15, email_status = $16, phone = $17, phone_type = $18,
  linkedin_followers = $19::int, linkedin_connections = $20::int, research_summary = $21, talking_points = $22,
  icp_fit = $23, enrichment = $24::jsonb, status = 'enriched'
where id = $1::uuid and status in ('received', 'enriching', 'error')
returning *
) select * from _r

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$json.lead_id ?? null, $json.first_name ?? null, $json.last_name ?? null, $json.full_name ?? null, $json.title ?? null, $json.headline ?? null, $json.location ?? null, $json.about ?? null, $json.company_name ?? null, $json.company_domain ?? null, $json.company_linkedin_url ?? null, $json.company_size ?? null, $json.industry ?? null, $json.company_description ?? null, $json.work_email ?? null, $json.email_status ?? null, $json.phone ?? null, $json.phone_type ?? null, $json.linkedin_followers ?? null, $json.linkedin_connections ?? null, $json.research_summary ?? null, $json.talking_points ?? null, $json.icp_fit ?? null, JSON.stringify($json.enrichment)] }}
